title: Inline text elements: sub, bdo, abbr, q, var and br
blurb: Subscripts that drop into their formulas, arrows that show the order of right-to-left text, an abbreviation whose title opens between two lines, large quotation marks behind a <q>, every <var> of one name outlined together, and a note that folds at its <br> elements.
question: Inline elements aren't drawable by themselves. How much can a canvas do with sub, sup, bdo, abbr, q, var and br from their rectangles alone?
result: Enough for all six effects in Chromium 157. sub, sup, abbr, q and var have boxes, and a draw of the paragraph clipped to a box moves that element alone. Client rectangles follow the last draw and offset numbers do not. A br has a rectangle 0 px wide, so fold lines come from a Range over the text between breaks. The title of an abbr isn't in the picture.
